clusters.observed_symptom: The current benchmark foundation records completed goals but cannot drive and deterministically judge arbitrary multi-turn legacy conversations; two official contracts also lack complete scenario-level drivers.
clusters.likely_subsystem: benchmark campaign runner and evidence adapters
clusters.evidence: Existing targeted tests cover component contracts, while no reusable scenario loader binds legacy conversations to journal/goal evidence. No legacy case was promoted to PASS from static capability presence.
clusters.expected_blast_radius: All imported natural-language, multi-turn, ambiguity, change-of-mind, unavailable-attachment, and action-routing cases.
clusters.suggested_phase3_action: Build an isolated conversation scenario runner with scripted/mock provider turns, fixture workspaces, journal capture, and deterministic criterion adapters before rerunning the same frozen IDs.
